comparison.objective: Apply and align a glass screen protector using a close-fitting tray; candidate separates finishing media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Planar precision alignment, tray-over-phone fitting, adhesive activation and tray removal versus lifting and dynamically orienting a loaded perforated screen.
comparison.success_condition: Glass flat and within 1.5 mm, tray removed, hands clear and still for 1 second versus mass recovery, washer retention, supported reseating and 3-second dwell.
comparison.reason: This is a precision lamination/alignment task with adhesion, not loose-body sorting through apertures; no plausible duplicate arises from the shared lift-and-release primitive.
